description: PowerShell encoded command - common obfuscation technique
remediation: Enable PowerShell script block logging (Event ID 4104), restrict execution policy, monitor for -EncodedCommand usage via Sysmon or Windows Event Logs

description: PowerShell launched with hidden window and no profile - stealth execution pattern
remediation: Alert on powershell.exe with -WindowStyle Hidden via process creation events (Event ID 4688 or Sysmon ID 1)

description: cmd.exe used for variable expansion or chained commands - common in dropper scripts
remediation: Enable process command-line auditing (Event ID 4688), monitor cmd.exe spawned by Office or browser processes

description: WScript or CScript executing VBS/JS files - frequently used in phishing-delivered malware
remediation: Block wscript.exe and cscript.exe via AppLocker or Software Restriction Policies where not required

description: MSHTA executing remote or inline script - common LOLBin abuse for payload delivery
remediation: Block mshta.exe via AppLocker, monitor for mshta spawning network connections or child processes

description: Scheduled task creation via schtasks.exe or at.exe - used for persistence and delayed execution
remediation: Monitor Event ID 4698 (task created), audit schtasks.exe command-line args, restrict task creation to admins

description: Windows service created or reconfigured via sc.exe - used to install malicious services
remediation: Monitor Event ID 7045 (new service installed), alert on sc.exe spawned by non-admin or unexpected parent

description: Registry Run key modification for persistence - executes payload on every user login
remediation: Monitor registry writes to HKLM/HKCU Run keys via Sysmon Event ID 13, alert on reg.exe or PowerShell modifying Run keys

description: User-level Run key persistence - attacker maintains access per user login without admin rights
remediation: Alert on HKCU Run key writes from non-standard processes, use Autoruns or registry auditing to baseline

description: New local account created or added to Administrators group - classic backdoor persistence
remediation: Monitor Event ID 4720 (account created) and 4732 (added to privileged group), alert on net.exe spawned by suspicious parent

description: Linux local account creation or sudo group modification - persistence via new privileged user
remediation: Monitor /etc/passwd and /etc/sudoers changes, alert on useradd/usermod from non-admin sessions

description: Malicious Windows service registered with binary in temp or appdata path
remediation: Alert on new services with binaries in writable paths (Temp, AppData), monitor Event ID 7045

description: Mimikatz or LSASS credential dumping tool detected - dumps plaintext passwords from memory
remediation: Enable Credential Guard, protect LSASS via RunAsPPL, alert on abnormal LSASS memory access (Sysmon Event ID 10)

description: LSASS process dump via ProcDump or comsvcs.dll minidump - stealthy credential harvesting
remediation: Block procdump against lsass via WDAC, monitor for comsvcs.dll MiniDump calls via Sysmon

description: SAM, SYSTEM, or SECURITY hive exported - used offline to crack local account password hashes
remediation: Monitor registry export commands targeting SAM/SYSTEM/SECURITY hives, alert on reg.exe with save subcommand

description: Pass-the-Hash indicators - authenticating with NTLM hash instead of plaintext password
remediation: Enable Protected Users group, disable NTLM where possible, monitor Event ID 4624 logon type 3 with NTLM auth

description: SMB lateral movement via admin shares or remote execution tools like PsExec
remediation: Monitor Event ID 5140 (network share accessed), restrict admin shares, alert on psexec patterns in process logs

description: RDP lateral movement activity - session hijacking or remote access to other hosts
remediation: Restrict RDP access, enable NLA, monitor Event ID 4624 logon type 10, alert on tscon for session hijacking

description: WinRM used for remote command execution - lateral movement via PowerShell remoting
remediation: Restrict WinRM access to admin hosts, monitor Event ID 4688 for wsmprovhost.exe, log PS remoting sessions

description: System enumeration commands run in sequence - attacker profiling the compromised host
remediation: Correlate discovery commands in short time windows, alert on bursts of enumeration from a single process tree

description: Process enumeration - attacker checking for security tools, AV, or EDR processes
remediation: Flag tasklist/wmic process queries from non-interactive sessions or spawned by Office/browser processes

description: Network connection or host discovery enumeration - mapping the internal network
remediation: Alert on nmap or mass ping from non-network-admin hosts, correlate with other discovery indicators

description: Active Directory group and user enumeration - attacker mapping domain structure
remediation: Monitor LDAP queries (Event ID 1644), alert on dsquery/nltest from workstations, restrict AD read permissions

description: Searching for credentials in files - attacker hunting for plaintext passwords in configs or scripts
remediation: Audit file access on sensitive config paths, scan codebase for hardcoded credentials, use secrets management

description: Windows Credential Manager access or stored credential dumping
remediation: Monitor vaultcmd.exe and cmdkey.exe usage, audit Credential Manager access via Event ID 5379

description: CertUtil used to download or decode files - classic LOLBin for payload staging
remediation: Block certutil network access via firewall, monitor certutil with -urlcache or -decode flags (Sysmon ID 1)

description: BITS job used to download files - abused for stealthy persistence and C2 downloads
remediation: Monitor Event ID 59/60/61 (BITS operational log), alert on bitsadmin spawned by non-system processes

description: PowerShell downloading and executing remote code via IEX or WebClient - fileless execution
remediation: Enable AMSI, block outbound HTTP from powershell.exe via firewall, alert on IEX + DownloadString combination

description: Environment variable obfuscation to disguise cmd.exe execution - evades simple string matching
remediation: Use behavioral detection rather than string matching, monitor process creation with expanded env variables

description: UAC bypass technique detected - elevating privileges without triggering UAC prompt
remediation: Set UAC to Always Notify, monitor auto-elevation of fodhelper/eventvwr, alert on registry writes to HKCU\Software\Classes\ms-settings

description: Process injection API calls detected - injecting shellcode into legitimate processes
remediation: Enable Windows Defender Exploit Guard, monitor Sysmon Event ID 8 (CreateRemoteThread), use EDR behavioral detection

description: LOLBin proxy execution via rundll32/regsvr32 to bypass application whitelisting
remediation: Restrict rundll32/regsvr32 with AppLocker, monitor for these binaries making network connections (Sysmon ID 3)

description: Windows Firewall or Defender disabled via netsh or sc - attacker removing defensive controls
remediation: Monitor Event ID 2003/2004 (firewall policy changed), protect security services via tamper protection

description: Windows Defender real-time monitoring disabled or exclusion added via PowerShell
remediation: Enable tamper protection in Defender, monitor Event ID 5007 (Defender config changed), alert on Set-MpPreference calls

description: Windows event logs cleared - attacker destroying forensic evidence post-compromise
remediation: Forward logs to SIEM in real time, monitor Event ID 1102 (audit log cleared) and 104 (system log cleared)

description: Shadow copies deleted or recovery disabled - pre-ransomware activity to prevent restoration
remediation: Alert immediately on vssadmin delete shadows, protect VSS via tamper protection, maintain offsite backups

description: File downloaded from external URL via curl, wget, or PowerShell - staging attacker tools
remediation: Monitor outbound HTTP/HTTPS from non-browser processes, use proxy inspection, alert on curl/wget from servers

description: DNS TXT record queries - DNS tunneling or C2 channel using encoded data in DNS responses
remediation: Monitor DNS query logs for high-frequency or long TXT record queries, use DNS filtering (e.g. Umbrella)

description: File permissions weakened or file hidden via attrib - attacker enabling access or hiding malware
remediation: Monitor icacls/attrib usage on sensitive paths, alert on world-writable permissions set on system directories

description: Token impersonation for privilege escalation - abusing SeImpersonatePrivilege (Potato attacks)
remediation: Remove SeImpersonatePrivilege from non-service accounts, monitor for token manipulation via Sysmon, patch Potato vulnerabilities

description: Network share enumeration via net view/share - low severity, common admin activity but worth logging
remediation: Correlate with other discovery events, alert only if run from non-admin accounts or in bulk

description: Repeated ping to remote hosts - basic host discovery, very common but flags bulk scanning
remediation: Baseline normal ping usage, alert on high-frequency pings from workstations to multiple targets

description: Recursive directory listing - attacker searching filesystem for interesting files
remediation: Flag recursive dir/find commands from interactive sessions on servers, correlate with other indicators

description: Logged-on user enumeration via quser/query user - attacker checking who else is on the system
remediation: Low priority standalone, escalate if combined with lateral movement or credential access events

description: Local group and account policy enumeration - passive reconnaissance of privilege structure
remediation: Correlate with account creation or privilege escalation events for higher fidelity alerting

description: HTTP HEAD requests probing servers - lightweight reconnaissance to check if services are alive
remediation: Low signal on its own, correlate with outbound scanning patterns or unusual target IPs

description: Hosts file read - attacker checking for internal hostname mappings or injected DNS entries
remediation: Low severity, monitor for writes to hosts file which would indicate DNS hijacking attempt

description: Environment variable enumeration - attacker checking PATH, credentials, or system config in env vars
remediation: Very low signal alone, useful as supporting indicator in a broader attack chain

description: Group Policy enumeration - attacker understanding policy restrictions before attempting bypass
remediation: Flag gpresult run by non-admin users, correlate with UAC bypass or policy modification attempts

description: Hardware and driver enumeration - low-level system profiling, sometimes precedes rootkit or driver exploit
remediation: Very low priority, useful as part of a multi-event correlation rule for full system reconnaissance
